insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day subject to maximum of Rs.5,000/- per day. Proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses if higher room chosen.

icu.note: ICU/ICCU expenses up to 2% of Sum Insured subject to maximum of Rs.10,000/- per day.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment. Policyholder may voluntarily opt for co-payment of 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, or 50% to presumably reduce premium.

sub_limits.note: Extensive disease/procedure sub-limits: Cardiac (CABG ₹70k-₹80k, PTCA ₹50k-₹75k), Oncology ₹70k-₹1L, Cataract ₹15k-₹20k, Joint Replacement ₹70k-₹1L, Renal Transplant ₹70k-₹1L, Robotic surgery ₹40k-₹50k, Stem cell ₹75k-₹1L, and many more. Modern treatment sub-limits also apply.

deductible.note: A 'Defined Limit' (aggregate deductible) applies; insurer's liability begins only when admissible hospitalization expenses exceed the chosen Defined Limit of ₹1L, ₹2L, ₹3L, ₹4L, or ₹5L per policy period. This is a mandatory feature of the product.

initial_waiting.note: Expenses for any illness within 30 days from first policy commencement date excluded, except accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 36 months of continuous coverage. No reducible option mentioned.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specified diseases/procedures (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, cardiac, ENT, thyroid, etc.) excluded for 36 months of continuous coverage.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl 18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: No Claim Bonus is referenced in renewal/portability/migration context (credits protected) but no explicit NCB accumulation rate or cap is stated in the policy wording.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalization expenses covered up to 15 days before hospitalization, subject to maximum of Rs.5,000/- per hospitalization. Not applicable for day care claims.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalization expenses covered up to 15 days after discharge, subject to maximum of Rs.5,000/- per hospitalization. Not applicable for day care claims.

day_care.note: All day care treatments covered up to Sum Insured.

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary treatment benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to Sum Insured. Yoga and Naturopathy require prior Company approval.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor expenses not mentioned as a covered benefit. Transplant surgeries are listed under sub-limits (Coverage 5, item 8) but donor harvesting expenses are not explicitly covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance cover is not mentioned in the policy wording.

modern_treatments.note: Modern treatments covered but with specific sub-limits per procedure (e.g., Robotic surgery ₹40k-₹50k, Stem cell ₹75k-₹1L, Oral chemo ₹25k-₹40k, Intra-vitreal injections ₹25k-₹40k, etc.).

consumables.note: Consumables are listed as items subsumed into room/procedure charges (i.e., not separately payable), and no consumables cover rider is mentioned.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause states all treatments must be taken in India.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: Free look period of 30 days from receipt of policy document for new policies only (not renewals or portability).

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines. Credits for PED, specific waiting periods, NCB, moratorium transferable.

notable_exclusions.display: Defined Limit deductible mandatory; maternity excluded; no domiciliary; no ambulance; no global cover; extensive disease sub-limits; all transplants in 36mo wait
